summary: An observation capture needs its own identity, and departure, arrival and route captures of one station are separate histories that must never be compared or averaged together.
reason: iRail has no historical endpoint, so every history answer is reconstructed from locally captured rounds. Keying a round by a wall-clock second let two captures in the same second collapse under INSERT OR IGNORE, and reading rounds back by station alone let a departures capture be diffed against an arrivals capture, inventing cancellations and platform changes that never happened.
validated_outcome: internal/cli/observation_scope_test.go pins both properties: two captures sharing an observed_at second stay distinct rounds, and changes/punctuality read exactly one board type at a time.
